data.gender_notes: Niraimathi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nirai - compassion, Mathi - Goddess. The name Niraimathi signifies the goddess of compassion. In Hindu mythology, she is believed to embody the deepest emotions and feelings of love and kindness. The name Niraimathi carries the meaning “Goddess of compassion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Niraimathi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of compassion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Niraimathi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of compassion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Niraimathi total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
